company_name: Shanghai Brother Microelectronics Technology Co., Ltd.
semiconductor_relevance: High — The company provides critical gas and chemical delivery systems essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Shanghai Brother Microelectronics Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in the design and manufacture of ultra-high purity gas and chemical delivery systems for the semiconductor industry. Their offerings include gas cabinets, vacuum manifold boxes, scrubbers, and chemical delivery systems, which are crucial for maintaining the purity and efficiency of semiconductor manufacturing environments.

regional_presence.China: The company operates a Class 1000 cleanroom and utilizes advanced equipment for manufacturing in China.
